# PersonAddress

An address on a person record, returned when $expand=addresses is requested. The expansion returns only the best known type=Home address and the best known type=Mailing address — at most two entries, and the same address appears twice (once per type, sharing an addressId) when it serves as both. type=Work and type=Custom addresses are stored but not surfaced here.

| Property | Type | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `addressId` | integer (int64) | Read-only; unique identifier of the address on this person. Shared by the Home and Mailing entries when one address fills both roles. |
| `type` | string | Which role the address plays for the person. This expansion only ever returns "Voting" or "Mailing", even though the database can also store "Work" and "Custom"; a person with no mailing address of their own has their home address returned under "Mailing" as well. One of: `Voting`, `Mailing`. |
| `addressLine1` | string or null | First line of the standardized street address. |
| `addressLine2` | string or null | Second line of the street address. |
| `addressLine3` | string or null | Third line of the street address. |
| `unitNo` | string or null | Read-only; the unit or apartment number parsed out of the street address by standardization. |
| `city` | string | City or town. Inferred from the postal code when not written. |
| `stateOrProvince` | string | Two or three character state or province code, e.g. "MN", "ON", "NSW". Inferred from the postal code when not written. |
| `zipOrPostalCode` | string | ZIP, ZIP+4, postal code, post code, etc. An empty string — not null — when the stored address has none. |
| `geoLocation` | any | Read-only; the geocoded position of the address. |
| `countryCode` | string | Two character ISO country code supported by the VAN context, e.g. "US". Defaults to the context's country. |
| `preview` | string | Read-only; a one-line display form of the street address. A single space when there are no street lines. |
| `isPreferred` | boolean | Read-only; whether this is the person's preferred address. It marks the entry filling the `Voting` slot: `true` on that entry, and on the `Mailing` entry only when the same address fills both slots. A mailing address of the person's own always reads `false`. |
| `isBest` | boolean | Read-only; whether this is the best known address of its type — the most recently added address of that type. **The flag is per type**, so a person can have two best addresses at once, one `Voting` and one `Mailing` (and when a single address fills both slots, that one address is returned twice, best in each). In practice the field carries no information on read: this expansion returns nothing but the best `Voting` and the best `Mailing` address, so every entry it returns reads `true`. To learn that an older address exists at all, match it with `POST /people/find`. |
| `streetAddress` | string or null | Read-only; the street portion of the standardized address. |
| `displayMode` | string | Read-only; which form of the address the other fields show — "Standardized" for the normalized version rather than the raw text as entered. |

`*` = required.
